title: Constructibility of the actual graded coefficient layer
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of independent coefficient universe, J an ideal, and N an actual constant-A pro-etale derived object [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. Suppose its residue reduction N_0 is bounded with affine-locally constructible cohomology [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. For each n let I_n=ker(A/J^(n+2) -> A/J^(n+1)) and let L_n=N_(n+1) tensor^L_(A/J^(n+2)) underline(I_n)[0] be the concretely defined layer of [lem-sfb-adic-coefficient-filtration-triangle]. Every H^q(L_n) is affine-locally constructible over A/J^(n+2) [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]. This asserts constructibility only of the graded layer, not of a higher reduction, and asserts no lower cohomological bound.

Apply the finite constant tensor theorem to the bounded constructible residue reduction and the proved finite graded module.

The quotient factor B to C is surjective by Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective. Apply exact surjective coefficient restriction to the residue tensor, then transport its q-th cohomology constructibility across the image of the graded-layer isomorphism.
